onChange.template: [Category: movement] Apply the Dynamic art style to Ground Locomotion. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Smooth art style to Ground Locomotion. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Precise art style to Ground Locomotion. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/ground_locomotion.schema.json, set glc_mode to {{glc_mode}}]
Set ground locomotion physics mode to {{glc_mode}} (useForceAsInputs in MovementAbility).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/ground_locomotion.schema.json, set glc_accel to {{glc_accel}}]
Set enableAcceleration to {{glc_accel}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/ground_locomotion.schema.json, set glt_move_speed to {{glt_move_speed}}]
Set moveSpeed to {{glt_move_speed}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/ground_locomotion.schema.json, set glt_accel_time to {{glt_accel_time}}]
Set accelerationTime to {{glt_accel_time}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/ground_locomotion.schema.json, set glt_decel_factor to {{glt_decel_factor}}]
Set decelerationFactor to {{glt_decel_factor}} in MovementAbility.
